sources_summary.name: Enron Email Dataset
sources_summary.authoritative_source: Carnegie Mellon University School of Computer Science (https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~enron/)
sources_summary.license: Public investigatory record released for research (no explicit formal open-source license grant)
limitations: Unlabeled legitimate/business corpus mapped to benign as a modeling assumption; not natively labeled benign.
Historical corporate email from 1999-2002; formatting and headers differ from modern email ecosystems.
No formal open-source license grant from FERC or CMU; distributed as an investigatory research release.
sources_summary.verification_notes: FERC investigatory public record made available for research; CMU redacted certain sensitive personal and financial information per requests of former employees. Unlabeled legitimate/business corpus -> benign mapping is a modeling assumption for the MAILTRACE training taxonomy, not an original threat label supplied by Enron.

sources_summary.name: Apache SpamAssassin Public Corpus
sources_summary.license: Apache SpamAssassin testing corpus / donated user email (software is Apache 2.0; individual donated emails lack separate license grants)
limitations: Spam category remains unresolved and rejected from training to prevent label noise.
Corpus dates from 2002-2005; does not reflect modern threat vectors.
Donated email archives lack individual copyright releases.
sources_summary.verification_notes: Corpus intended by Apache SpamAssassin for spam filter evaluation and testing. Only easy_ham and hard_ham represent legitimate emails. The spam partition is unresolved and rejected because commercial bulk spam cannot be safely mapped to phishing or suspicious without specific threat indicators.

sources_summary.name: Nazario Phishing Corpus
sources_summary.license: No explicit license provided on distribution site (public research archive of adversarial emails)
limitations: No explicit software or data license provided on monkey.org.
Contains raw malicious URLs, dead phishing links, and deceptive sender domains.
Total sample count is unverified prior to downloading and parsing individual mbox files.
sources_summary.verification_notes: Longitudinal archival collection of raw phishing emails collected via honeypots between 2005 and 2024. Contains authentic adversarial credential lures and fraudulent links. The distribution site monkey.org does not provide a formal license.

sources_summary.name: BEC-2 Research Corpus
sources_summary.authoritative_source: Rohit Dube, UC Berkeley (Preprint: 'Building a Business Email Compromise Research Dataset with Large Language Models', Oct 2024)
sources_summary.license: Unverified / Author distribution upon research request
limitations: Public BEC data is substantially more limited than general legitimate/phishing email data. BEC-2 provides 279 generated samples based on real-world BEC examples rather than a large authentic mailbox corpus.
Provenance: LLM-generated variations, not authentic historical mailbox records.
License and distribution unverified; requires direct research contact.
sources_summary.verification_notes: Contains 279 synthetic BEC emails generated by an LLM based on variations of real-world BEC scenarios. While validated with human analyst agreement scores, samples are researcher-generated rather than authentic mailbox telemetry. Must never be represented as authentic historical emails. No public open-source license is verified.

sources_summary.name: IWSPA APWG Phishing Corpus
sources_summary.authoritative_source: Anti-Phishing Working Group (APWG) / IWSPA Shared Task (https://apwg.org/resources/)
sources_summary.license: Restricted APWG Member Agreement / Institutional NDA Required
limitations: Requires APWG membership / institutional data use agreement.
Cannot be downloaded or distributed automatically.
sources_summary.verification_notes: Restricted institutional access. Requires signed institutional research agreement and membership with APWG. No automated download permitted.

Apache SpamAssassin Public Corpus.provenance_notes: Standard open spam benchmark. Only ham archives are eligible for benign training; generic bulk spam remains unresolved and rejected.

Nazario Phishing Corpus.provenance_notes: Verified security research collection referenced across academic anti-phishing literature. Raw adversarial email telemetry without formal license grant.

BEC-2 Research Corpus.provenance_notes: Generated from real-world BEC examples using LLMs. Not authentic collected mailbox corpus. Distributed via research preprint author contact.
